definition: An autosomal dominant motor neuropathy (also referred to as HMND11) associated with heterozygous mutations—including loss-of-function and nonsense variants—in the SPTAN1 gene encoding alpha-II-spectrin, characterized primarily by progressive distal muscle weakness and atrophy, which may also encompass overlapping neuropathic, myopathic, or neurodevelopmental features.

source.title: A novel de novo SPTAN1 nonsense variant causes hereditary motor neuropathy in a Chinese family
source.quote: … (2019) about autosomal dominant distal hereditary motor neuropathy (dHMN) caused by … pathogenic SPTAN1 variants exhibiting a broad spectrum of neurodevelopmental phenotypes, …
